scope: Shaders, pipeline caches, compilation jobs and neighbouring formatter paths

deviceContext.observedCompilerMode: Legacy Recompiler (single-threaded) for all three games in build595 evidence

investigations.hypothesis: Repeated placeholder parsing adds avoidable CPU work during synchronous shader decompilation.
investigations.codeEvidence: The old callback overload tests all 11 vertex or 19 fragment placeholder strings at every literal character using temporary substrings, then erase/insert shifts the remaining suffix. All production placeholder keys start with '$'.
investigations.potential: Medium for synchronous decompilation bursts; cannot affect a frame with no compilation.
investigations.feasibility: High; output-preserving string algorithm with no GPU dependency.
investigations.risk: Callback order, empty replacements, inserted dollar signs, unknown tokens and TEXBEM two-stage redirection.
investigations.change: iOS helper finds '$' boundaries and appends unchanged literal spans; retains ordered matching and never reparses emitted replacement strings.
investigations.verification: 76,391 exact Format comparisons per mode, including all 91 production literals containing tokens, 10,000 generated inputs, embedded NULs, empty/long/token-like results, both redirect opcodes, ignore_redirects and native half states. Plain and ASan/UBSan pass. Original and current desktop output also agree.

investigations.hypothesis: std::bind member-call wrappers allocate every Format invocation even when their token is absent.
investigations.codeEvidence: Seven vertex and three fragment wrappers store this plus a member-function pointer (and sometimes an argument) in std::function. Their replacement lambdas capture only this.
investigations.potential: Medium for shader preparation, no new shader reuse or reduced driver compilation claimed.
investigations.risk: Preserve exact target method, arguments and lazy invocation.
investigations.change: Use this-capturing lambdas with the same method calls. This equivalent wrapper change also applies to desktop; the new token scanner itself remains iOS-only.
investigations.verification: The exact original and replacement Format methods compile in the differential harness. Literal-only 3,000-call workload allocation count: fragment 12,000 to 3,000; vertex 24,000 to 3,000. One output-string allocation per call remains. Callback order matches in all Format tests.

investigations.hypothesis: Full-body and instruction-body generation repeat the same formatting work.
investigations.codeEvidence: AddCode calls Format(code) twice without intervening renderer state mutation. Reachable callbacks register declarations, insert constant IDs, and OR the indexed-constant flag; these operations are idempotent.
investigations.potential: Halves Format calls from this vertex decompilation path.
investigations.risk: Keep the original extra semicolon only in m_body and preserve declaration/constant registration.
investigations.change: On iOS, format once, append the semicolon for m_body and move the same original text into the per-instruction body.
investigations.verification: 10,913 AddCode comparisons per mode: both output vectors and declarations match; callback invocations are exactly halved. Callback operand decoding is a disclosed host adapter, not a full GLSL/driver execution.

investigations.hypothesis: A shader map entry may be consumed before its compiler publishes ready.
investigations.codeEvidence: The ordinary map-hit path can return an incomplete shader, while recent hints require ready. The parallel caller is preload_programs, which discards those references. load_shaders joins its complete named_thread_group before compile_shaders starts consuming shader fields. Runtime draws use the RSX thread after preload.
investigations.potential: High if a new concurrently consuming caller were introduced.
investigations.feasibility: Needs an actual consumer overlap before introducing a new wait.
investigations.risk: An unnecessary wait would serialize independent preload work.
investigations.status: not reproduced on current call graph
investigations.verification: All preload_programs/add_pipeline_entry call sites and the two joined phases were inspected. No new wait or ready policy is added. This is not proof that arbitrary future concurrent callers are safe.

investigations.hypothesis: Deferred compute job copies may retain a pointer into a temporary entry-name string.
investigations.codeEvidence: compute_data = props constructs a temporary compute_pipeline_props whose implicit assignment copies stage.pName. Small strings can therefore leave pName pointing into the destroyed temporary. Every current compute consumer in VKCompute forces COMPILE_INLINE, bypassing this job constructor.
investigations.potential: Correctness issue for future deferred compute, no current gameplay gain established.
investigations.feasibility: A copy/assignment rebasing fix is straightforward but outside an executed path here.
investigations.risk: Specialization info and other pNext ownership would also need a complete deferred-compute contract.
investigations.verification: Repository-wide compile/get_pipe_compiler call sites checked. The graphics jobs used by legacy rendering do not use compute_data.

investigations.hypothesis: Unused logic op/min sample shading state creates unnecessary pipeline variants.
investigations.codeEvidence: Dynamic states and disabled blending/depth/stencil are already normalized on the private key. decode_rsx_state constructs a fresh zeroed properties object each time, setting logicOp only when enabled and sampleShadingEnable/minSampleShading together. The suspected stale inactive fields are not generated by this live path.
investigations.potential: Low for this specific extension; existing normalization is retained.
investigations.feasibility: No useful live-state difference to remove demonstrated.
investigations.risk: Front-face/cull or sample-shading normalization could alter shader/front-facing and coverage semantics.
investigations.verification: Inspected decoded state, validation, pipeline hash/equality and compiler dynamic-state declarations. No additional normalizer or cache reset is added.

investigations.hypothesis: Repeated persistence and duplicate raw-program loads add stalls and memory retention.
investigations.codeEvidence: Existing persistence is already deferred and unchanged libraries skip serialization. Repeated raw payload I/O was confirmed in the executed load/unpack path. The candidate retained per-record properties, actual FP-byte hash checks and existing ownership/release; only immutable verified raw data was reused. Vertex data was not shared because per-record instruction masks participate in validation.
investigations.potential: The 256-repeat 8 KiB payload test reduces reads and temporary owned bytes: 256 to 1 with one worker, 256 to 8 with eight workers in the final measured case. Per-worker multiple-payload repeats are less effective. These are constructed workloads, not the games cache inventory.
investigations.feasibility: Implemented and functionally exercised, but not retained because a general startup gain is unproved and unique-payload cases regress.
investigations.risk: Additional key checks/hash proof routing and per-worker scratch initialization cost remain when no payload repeats. Shared versions also contend. Actual game raw-cache files are unavailable, so their duplicate frequency cannot justify that tradeoff.
investigations.status: three implementations tested and withdrawn from production
investigations.verification: Real temporary files, exact load_shaders/unpack/load_fp_raw/FP hash and lf_fifo/ownership methods: 4,096 record results checked, eight 1/8-worker scenarios, four corrupt/missing/short/oversized recovery cases, collisions, repeated load lifetime, cancellation and desktop equivalence. Three designs measured: shared blocking slots, shared try_lock slots with reused byte-hash proof, then worker-private slots without locks. First two show unique/collision regressions. Final seven-sample run: duplicates improve, but unique 8-worker median 2.03 to 2.34 ms (+15.5%).
investigations.change: No final rsx_cache.h change. Three exact candidate fixtures are retained for reproduction.

investigations.hypothesis: Generalize the formatter into the redirect prepass and simplify swizzles.
investigations.codeEvidence: TEXBEM first replaces '$0' even inside '$$0', before the callback parser consumes '$$'. Merging the two passes changes '$$0' from '$x2d' to '$0'. ShaderVariable::simplify also emits by unordered_map iteration, but it has no current call site; constructor/match_size/add_mask are the used methods.
investigations.potential: Low relative to the retained formatting algorithm.
investigations.feasibility: Redirect fusion needs exact two-pass semantics; swizzle helper is unused.
investigations.risk: Different generated GLSL and possible rendering regression.
investigations.verification: Both redirect opcodes, escaped tokens and inserted replacement tokens remain covered in the before/after differential tests. Unused simplify is not edited.

knownTestDevelopmentFailures: The first adapter incorrectly exposed both templated fragment GetSRC and scalar vertex GetSRC on one base class and omitted src0/src1/src2; corrected by modelling their distinct class interfaces.
GCC inlined the custom allocation counter and diagnosed mismatched-new-delete; allocation boundary functions are now noinline. No production warning or safety check was disabled.

Raw-preload adapter initially modelled umax as a fixed u64 and iterated lf_array allocated capacity instead of lf_fifo logical size. Both adapter errors were corrected; production safety checks stayed enabled.

The try_lock variant disproved an overly strict test bound of at most one initial read per worker: contention on ready hits can also fall back. The bound was corrected before performance evaluation, and that shared-lock design was subsequently withdrawn.
limitations: Exact formatter methods and replacement utility are compiled/executed; operand decoding callbacks are host adapters.
The full Core, glslang, SPIR-V module creation and MoltenVK pipeline compilation were not rebuilt or executed.
All 18 formatter timing pairs are retained; none regresses in this one host measurement. Single-host means are not device medians or gameplay measurements.
No GOW3 freeze, BO2 weapon/forearm or AC torch visual fix is established by this shader work.
Raw-preload experiments are plain host executions only, not ASan/TSan passes and not final runtime sources. They are deliberately excluded from the production patch.
